notes: ἄχρι and δεῦρο form one unit on 'hitherto' by rule 94's count test, aligned rather than noncompositional under rules 35 and 39 since 'hither' answers to δεῦρο and '-to' to ἄχρι; the intervening article stays unrepresented under rule 93 and the competing status is noted.
καθώς keeps a bare 'as' and the answering καί takes the written 'even' — rule 82's bare-even arm, not the correlative arm.
